description: A micro-ORM of extension methods on `DbConnection` that runs your SQL and maps each row to a typed object by column name.
The Dapper struct that bundles SQL, parameters, transaction, command type and a `CancellationToken` for one call.
The Dapper parameter bag that supports explicit types, sizes and output or return parameters, read back with `Get<T>`.
Dapper's rewrite of `IN @ids` into one parameter per element of the collection you pass.
Database-side code called with `CommandType.StoredProcedure`, common in SQL Server shops for reports and business rules.
The EF Core 8+ API that runs parameterized SQL and maps the rows to a scalar or an unmapped type without Dapper.
The EF Core method that exposes the context's own connection so Dapper can run on it, inside the same transaction when needed.
